assessment: Current unary checker returns null before establishing not result sort when its operand is unresolved. The candidate addresses that concrete admission bug with fixed constructor sorts and distinct completion/schema/constraint facts rather than disabling save alone.

The 23-tag profile is coherent with existing reference, predicate, Boolean, relational and quantifier constructors. Width, nominal ordering, join endpoints, transpose and equal-schema constraints remain independent obligations; unresolved facts do not create exact Check.types entries. Full unchanged 46-case complete checker parity remains mandatory runtime evidence.

Complete private structured violations and exact edge/role/rule/fact keys prevent capped display diagnostics, same-parent opposite operands and same-text changed nominal mismatches from laundering new errors. Before and after analyses must finish; allocation or propagation exhaustion rejects rather than authorizing from partial facts.

Fixed graph-derived variables/equations, finite monotone domains, canonical deduplication and explicit versioned counters make a bounded implementation feasible. Deterministic order-independent scheduling/resource classification is a substantive implementation obligation, explicitly exercised by PT-024/031; it is not established by this approval.

Persistent independent hole constraints and immutable slot/root sidecar distinguish explicit destination obligations from a replaced concrete expression inferred type. Tests cover subsequent filling, repeated replacement, copy/move remapping, destination-versus-internal ownership, removal and undo/redo. Analysis and all successful transaction paths must consume the same sidecar state.

Atomic drag preparation removes the existing select/copy publication hazard. PT-030 snapshots before the gesture and checks unrelated clipboard, third-node selection, active focus, generation and absence of deferred rejected-candidate focus. This is materially stronger than module-only rollback.

Test plan covers direct arbitrary drafts as well as every interaction route, scope/identity/bounds regressions, prior-invalid no-op controls, more than64 errors, forced resource exhaustion and actual browser regression. Frozen workload performance remains separate evidence, not a unit-test inference.
